reason: Booking.com takes around 15% of every stay, so if this site plus a tidy Google Maps profile brings me even two or three direct bookings a season, the €600 pays for itself. The domain being in my name was my first worry and they already answered it, and November is the right time to get it done before the season.
objection: A nice website doesn't bring guests by itself. If I don't show up higher on Google Maps and people still book through Booking.com, I've paid €600 for a brochure, and booking by WhatsApp with no calendar might mean messages about dates that are already taken.
would_change_my_mind: If at the meeting they can't show me sites they've done for other apartments on this coast and how those show up on Google, I would not go ahead.
